metadata.case_name: LIMBU PRYA v. HEI YUET PALACE RESTAURANT O/B KENBERG INVESTMENTS LTD

plaintiff.occupation_before: kitchen helper/cleaner at the Defendant's restaurant premises
plaintiff.occupation_after: part-time cleaner at a residential public housing block (3.8.2006 to end 2007); later part-time kitchen worker for about 4 to 5 months

injuries.description: second degree burns all over her back and buttocks with blistering. Estimated body surface area involvement is about 18%
source: On 14.11.2005 her back was severely scalded by very hot water.
She was examined by Dr. Wong Man Fung ("Dr. Wong") Dr. Wong found her to have second degree burns all over her back and buttocks with blistering. Estimated body surface area involvement is about 18%.
injuries.icd_description: Injuries to the abdomen, lower back, lumbar spine or pelvis

injuries.description: areas of hypo-pigmented skin and at least one area of hyper-trophic scar on her back
source: On her back there are areas of hypo-pigmented skin and at least one area of hyper-trophic scar.
She said that if she touches the area of her back with the hypo-pigmentation and hyper-trophic scar it is painful.
injuries.icd_description: Other specified superficial injury of abdomen, lower back or pelvis

manifestations.description: pain when touching the area of her back with the hypo-pigmentation and hyper-trophic scar
restrictions of the injured skin to normal movements were minimal
her ability to tolerate full movements in order to work full-time (8 hours per day) might be hampered significantly by lack of rehabilitation support
pain at her back causing her to give up part-time work

treatments_received: went to the accident and emergency department at Queen Mary Hospital (QMH) on 14.11.2005
examined by Dr. Wong Man Fung
transferred from QMH to the Tung Wah Hospital on 18.11.2005
discharged from Tung Wah Hospital on 26.11.2005
examined by Dr. James Kong, a specialist in plastic surgery, in July 2008
treatments_future: counselling and support (recommended by Dr. James Kong)

losses.description: Areas of hypo-pigmented skin and at least one area of hyper-trophic scar on her back; painful on touch
Did not return to former full-time work at the Defendant's kitchen and later gave up part-time jobs because of pain and limitation of movement
